items.title: Berlin company launches AI kick drum generator trained on its own audio dataset
items.excerpt: Berlin-based Just 4 Noise launched Just 4 Kicks, an AI plugin that generates royalty-free kick drum samples with genre, texture, style and length controls; its model was trained only on audio its own team recorded on analogue gear.

items.title: This New AI Music Model Is Already Better Than Suno—We Put ACE to the Test
items.excerpt: ACE Studio's ACE Music v1 took first place on Artificial Analysis' blind vocal-music leaderboard (1,160 Elo vs Suno v6's 1,144); Decrypt's tests found stronger melodies, more natural vocals and cleaner endings, though Suno handled niche genres better. Off-list source: no allowed-domain coverage of this model release.

items.title: Idol’s Labelcamp and startup MyPart explore AI connections
items.excerpt: Idol's distribution-management platform Labelcamp launched an AI Connector letting labels and distributors run supply-chain operations and catalogue analytics from Claude or ChatGPT; startup MyPart also added agentic AI connections.

items.title: Influur Pulse 2.0 Uses AI to Simplify Music Influencer Campaigns
items.excerpt: Influur's Pulse 2.0 is an AI agent for label marketing teams that discovers creators, runs outreach, automates music influencer campaigns through to payment, and measures results.

items.title: Carmine Appice On Using AI To Create Cactus Music Videos
items.excerpt: Drummer Carmine Appice (Vanilla Fudge, Cactus, Jeff Beck, Rod Stewart) explains how he is now using AI video tools to make music videos for Cactus.

items.title: "AI 목소리라고? 좋기만 한데?"…머무르 노래 음원차트 휩쓸자 편견도 무너졌다
items.excerpt: 인간이 기획·작사·작곡하고 AI로 보컬을 생성한 머무르의 '꿈꾸던 어른이 되었나요?'가 멜론 톱100 2위에 오르며 생성형 AI 보컬을 창작 도구로 받아들이는 분위기가 확산되고 있다.

items.title: 멜론 2위 AI 곡, 유튜브뮤직은 라벨 달고 국내 앱은 표시 기준 없어
items.excerpt: AI 보컬 곡 머무르 '꿈꾸던 어른이 되었나요?'가 멜론 2위에 올랐지만 멜론·플로·벅스는 AI 음악 표시 체계가 없고, 유튜브뮤직은 10월 14일부터 재생 화면에 AI 라벨을 붙이고 있다. Off-list source (DSP labelling angle).

items.title: 메이크어스, AI 활용해 음악 콘텐츠 촬영부터 마스터링까지 제작 공정 자동화 추진
items.excerpt: 메이크어스가 AI를 활용해 음악 콘텐츠 촬영부터 믹싱·마스터링까지 제작 공정을 자동화하는 체계를 추진한다. Off-list source (AI mastering slot had no on-list item).

items.title: AI 음악 유통 정책 갈라진 글로벌 플랫폼…사운드클라우드는 개방, 밴드캠프는 제한 - 미디어피아
items.excerpt: 글로벌 스트리밍 플랫폼의 AI 생성 음악 정책이 갈린다: 스포티파이는 AI 스팸 추천 노출 제한, 밴드캠프는 AI 생성 음악 제한, 사운드클라우드는 개방. Off-list source.

items.title: We Distributed Cloned AI Music From a Fake Nigerian Artist
items.excerpt: Investigation: the outlet built a fake Nigerian artist with a cloned voice and an AI-generated song, told distribution platforms exactly what it had done, and tracked which ones still distributed it. Off-list source.

items.title: DJ.Studio 5.0: DJ DAW Now Has Phrase Detection, Smart Beatgrid & More
items.excerpt: DJ.Studio 5.0, the DJ DAW, adds Phrase Detection and a Smart Beatgrid; its AI-powered Automix is renamed Harmonize and now orders playlists by tempo and harmonic match 15x faster.

items.title: Nvidia Moves to Quash Burdensome UMG v. Suno Subpoena
items.excerpt: Nvidia moved to quash a 'burdensome' deposition subpoena in UMG v. Suno, saying it has already produced more than 6,300 documents.

items.title: UMG v. Suno Discovery Dispute Rages Amid Marathon Legal Battle
items.excerpt: In the UMG v. Suno discovery dispute, Suno is now questioning whether the major labels actually have the rights to license their catalogues for AI training.

items.title: AI to Be Used to Make Idol Music Videos; HITGS and Genus Share Unreleased Songs - MK
items.excerpt: The 3rd Korea AI Advertising Awards opens a category where entrants make generative-AI music videos for unreleased songs by rookie idols from HITGS and Genus. Off-list source.

items.title: MusicFlux: Flexible Conditioning for Text-Guided Music Generation and Editing
items.excerpt: MusicFlux is a text-guided music editor built on a pretrained flow-matching text-to-audio model, with two conditioning approaches that trade editing quality against compute for inpainting, event insertion and restoration.

items.title: 뉴튠 이종필 대표, WIPO 회의 참석…'AI 음악 창작물' 권리 추적 체계 제시 - 뉴스컬처
items.excerpt: 뉴튠 이종필 대표가 WIPO 회의에서 생성형 AI 음악 창작물의 권리 추적·분류 체계를 제시했다. Off-list source.

items.title: [스타트업-ing] AI와 인간 재능의 공존 방법, 글로벌 음악 장터 ‘레몬사운드’로 본 가능성
items.excerpt: 글로벌 음악 장터 '레몬사운드' 사례로 본 AI와 인간 창작자의 공존 방식 — 스타트업 인터뷰. Off-list source.

items.title: ISINA Uses AI and Industry Connections to Help Emerging Artists Build Their Careers
items.excerpt: ISINA uses AI matching plus industry connections to help emerging artists find collaborators and develop careers. Off-list source.
